legacy_root.title: Executable stopping example: unique_ideas >= 100 AND completeness_score >= 0.90
legacy_root.question: What makes this expression executable end to end - specifically, which component of completeness_score is not yet defined anywhere, and does the conjunction ever become satisfiable if the idea counter and the completeness scorer disagree about what an idea is?

answer.undefined_component_detail: Catalog TST-0282 names three coverage legs (declared subquestions, required categories, evidence classes) but no live producer binds the idea-set those numerators union over. Identifier mentions in stopping-expression parsers and schema examples consume a snapshot key; they do not define coverage_domain_identity. Human-label calibration is a second undefined residual (not used as a gate here).

live_census.undefined_component_reason: Catalog TST-0282 names three coverage legs (declared subquestions, required categories, evidence classes) but no live producer binds the idea-set those numerators union over. Identifier mentions in stopping-expression parsers and schema examples consume a snapshot key; they do not define coverage_domain_identity. Human-label calibration is a second undefined residual (not used as a gate here).

answer.executable_because: A10 grammar accepts the spec string unchanged; unique_ideas is the canonical-mechanism cluster count (Jaccard is a corroborating second signal, never a merge against a different mechanism); completeness_score is min(subquestion coverage, category coverage, evidence-class coverage) unioned over those same clusters; the AND fires only when both metrics share IDENTITY_CANONICAL.
answer.conjunction_if_identities_disagree: Yes, the naive conjunction CAN be true: on the disagree fixture, raw-row unique_ideas=100 and gamed-tag completeness_score=1.0 so naive_and=true. That fire is invalid. The bound evaluator returns UNBOUND (does not FIRE) whenever unique_ideas and completeness_score were not computed under the same canonical-mechanism identity. Disagreement is therefore never a satisfied stop.
answer.residual_unknown: Human-label calibration of completeness_score (TST-0282 kappa) is not defined on this worktree and is NOT used as a gate. Operational coverage is the executable definition for this example.

bindings.bind_rule: FIRE only if unique_identity == completeness_identity == canonical-mechanism-v1 and both identity hashes match; otherwise UNBOUND/SILENT.

negative_control.state_meant_to_reject: 100-idea quota filled with wording variants of 8 mechanisms
negative_control.what_the_check_does: planted_bad: verdict=SILENT fired=False unique_ideas=8 completeness_score=0.2 n_raw=104 bound=True
negative_control.note: fired_on_bad_state means the detector *activates as a reject*: verdict=SILENT on planted-bad. silent_on_good_state means FIRE is reserved for the genuine 100-distinct complete ledger.
